description: Upload files from ChatGPT to your FilePost account, list and inspect account-owned files, check plan usage, change filename visibility, and delete selected files. Each uploaded file gets a public link accessible to anyone who has it. Requires a FilePost account. ChatGPT does not offer FilePost checkout, subscription changes, or payment collection.

defaultPrompt: Upload the attached file and give me its public link.
